title: The look and the front page of the game (content/rules/branding.json, schema v0)
description: What makes the app of a game look like that game and not another: the colours and the fonts of the app (a few of them, by name), a style sheet of its own, the front page (the blocks that the page at the address of the domain is made of) and what a link to the game shows when it is shared (the title, the description and the picture of the preview). Every part is optional, and a pack without this document, or with an empty one, is the app as it is: the car game's dark and amber look and its own front page. The colours are the ones that the app reads by name (bg, surface, ink, amber ...) and a colour that is not here is the app's. The fonts are chosen from the ones that the app brings or that every device has, since a font file is not something the game keeps. The style sheet is the last word on any rule of the app but cannot load anything from outside: it cannot import another sheet or a font, and a url() in it points only at a picture of the game (/api/v1/media/<name>), which the pack names by that url. The front page is a list of blocks of a few kinds, each with its texts in the languages of the game; it is data and not HTML, so that a page of the game never runs what a person typed in the panel.

colors.description: The colours of the app by their names; a colour left out is the app's own.

fonts.description: The fonts of the headings (display), of the text (sans) and of the numbers (mono), each one of the presets.

css.description: A style sheet that comes after the one of the app, so that it has the last word. No @import, no @font-face, no image-set(), and a url() only to a picture of the game.

landing.description: The page at the address of the domain, as the blocks it is made of, from the top. A game without it has the front page of the app.

share.description: What a link to the game shows where it is shared (the preview that a chat or a social network makes). A game without it shows its name.

font.description: A font by its preset: the ones the app brings (barlow-condensed, barlow, jetbrains-mono) and the ones every device has (system-sans, system-serif, system-mono).

line.description: A short text in the languages of the game: English and Polish are required, a language that is left out says the English text.

sentence.description: A text of a few sentences in the languages of the game.

paragraphs.description: A long text in the languages of the game; a blank line starts a new paragraph, and nothing in it is read as HTML.

block.description: One block of the front page. hero: the top of the page (eyebrow, title, subtitle, a picture and its description) with the buttons that start or go on with the game; features: one to six cards (kicker, title, text); text: a title and paragraphs; image: a picture with its description and a caption; cta: the buttons again, with a title and a sentence. The fields that a kind does not use are not read.
